1.e4 c5 2.Nf3 d6 3.c3 Nf6 4.Be2.strategy: Develops and prepares castling while guarding e4 tactically: ...Nxe4 runs into Qa4+, which wins the knight. It keeps the pawn without blocking the plan of a central pawn advance.

1.e4 c5 2.Nf3 d6 3.c3 Nf6 4.Be2 Nc6.strategy: Develops and adds control of d4 and e5, preparing to meet the central advance with piece pressure. Taking on e4 straight away still fails to Qa4+, so Black first completes development.
